summary.text: Ford Carr is a Democratic member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 84 (Sedgwick County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2022.

paragraphs.text: Ford Carr is listed as a member of the Child Welfare and Foster Care Committee, the Legislative Modernization Committee, the Transportation and Public Safety Budget Committee and the Welfare Reform Committee.
The Legislature lists Ford Carr's occupation as Engineer.
